title: P17 — Implement portable export/import and offline render
description:
## Dispatch packet P17
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D08 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
toolchain, cli
Primary paths: bundle schema validation; CLI export/import/render. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Implement D08 manifest, hashes, pinned assets/fonts/audio/deps and ZIP path validation. Add vml export and import/validate paths, render from frozen bundle; no live network capture. Reject arbitrary hosted dependencies.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
export fixture renders on clean consumer without Babulus creds; traversal/symlink/hash/version tests; PCM timing parity.

## Dependencies
videoml-684f74 (P02), videoml-48d9c8 (P15), videoml-2779f2 (P04)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Accepted review correction
D08 supports local trusted TS but hosted pilot validation accepts declarative built-in/approved effects only. Exported projects stay portable; report unsupported hosted custom code without mutating the source. Enforce compressed/expanded/file-count/path/hash limits.

comments.author: home
comments.text: P15 intentionally does not add a copied source digest that cannot independently validate all normalized source content. P17 must enforce D08 whole-bundle manifest hashes for source/script/frozen timing/audio and reject any mutated file; include narration text and component property tampering tests. This is the full content-integrity boundary, separate from P15 ordered-ID/timing/audio verification.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary D08a decisions now in initiative: one explicitly selected composition, required script/timing/assembled-audio roles, all files hashed with immutable job expected digest, canonical cross-platform paths, strict staged ZIP/directory import and AST+asset hosted validation. P17 scope includes specification schema/fixtures semantic validators as well as CLI/toolchain. No implementation started; P07 currently owns toolchain.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary recorded D08c secure Python3.9+ dirfd helper, no-follow traversal, private stage and platform no-replace atomic publish. Approved architecture sent to worker. Node check-then-open paths are not accepted as a race-safe importer. Explicit capability errors and runtime prerequisite documentation required.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Independent helper review found stage/parent publication substitution, partial-line timeout bypass and unlimited empty directories. Primary additionally found FIFO swap blocking-open and recursive nested-destination risk. Worker fixing before integration. D08c now explicitly requires trusted destination ownership/ancestors, excludes root/sameUID host compromise guarantees, requires distinct hosted renderer UID, and specifies bounded nonblocking protocol/enumeration plus source/destination disjointness. Stage inode and parent checks are defense in depth, not a claimed cure for hostile sameUID writers.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary reran13 current bundle tests: core paths/digest/roles, nine staging scenarios and ZIP malformed-header/traversal checks all pass. Independent corrected-helper source re-review found no new blocker within documented trust boundary. This is not P17 acceptance: semantic consistency, secure ZIP integration, public CLI, packed offline render and broader adversarial cases remain.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Wrapper source review found concurrency request misrouting, false successful abort after failed cleanup, uncertain commit outcome and EPIPE handling blockers. Worker added preflight/terminal commit, explicit BUNDLE_PUBLICATION_UNCONFIRMED after sent-commit response loss, clean-exit requirements and EPIPE fencing, with adversarial fake-helper tests; re-review pending. P17 not accepted or exposed through CLI.
